papers.title: C-LISTEN: Cognitive Load Impacts of Sensory-Triggered Environmental Navigation in Virtual Reality
papers.reason: The human pilot study uses navigation performance, postural balance, and pupil diameter to assess cognitive load, but focuses on VR interface design rather than executive-function modelling or clinical classification.

papers.title: Trajectories of Cognitive Functioning in Older Age Bipolar Disorder.
papers.reason: The study concerns longitudinal cognitive functioning in a clinical population but provides no stated focus on executive-function mechanisms or computational modelling.

papers.title: Association of Sarcopenia With Global, Motor, Cognitive, and Swallowing Function Prognosis in Stroke Patients: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
papers.reason: This review addresses broad cognitive and functional prognosis after stroke without a specific executive-function or digital-assessment component.

papers.title: Digital tools for assessing attention and executive functions in adults: a systematic review of validity and accessibility.
papers.reason: The review directly evaluates digital methods for measuring adult attention and executive function, making it highly relevant to scalable cognitive assessment.

papers.title: Exercise slows biological aging in breast cancer survivors: secondary analysis of a randomized trial.
papers.reason: The stated contribution concerns exercise and biological aging rather than executive function, cognitive modelling, neuroscience, or digital cognitive assessment.

papers.title: Loss of a spouse and risk of cognitive decline: insights from six prospective cohort studies
papers.reason: The paper examines a psychosocial risk factor for general cognitive decline without an indicated focus on executive processes or computational assessment.

papers.title: White matter microstructural integrity in SeLECTS: a diffusion tensor imaging study of cognitive and behavioral correlates.
papers.reason: The study combines DTI, EEG, and executive-function assessments in children with epilepsy, although its tract–behavior associations were exploratory and did not survive correction.

papers.title: Double-blind, randomized clinical trial targeting theta oscillations with transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) for cognitive control in male methamphetamine patients.
papers.reason: The trial directly tests the causal role of theta oscillations in cognitive control within a clinical population.

papers.title: Validation of a dual 2-back task as an effective method for inducing acute mental fatigue.
papers.reason: The study provides detailed behavioral and EEG findings on sustained visuospatial working-memory updating, including P300, frontal theta, and posterior alpha dynamics.

papers.title: Predictive modeling of a metabolism-linked cognitive neurodynamic system for Alzheimer’s disease using a radial basis scaled conjugate gradient neural network and electroencephalography-based multi-entropy analysis
papers.reason: The paper combines a disease-progression model with entropy-based EEG classification of Alzheimer’s disease, MCI, and healthy groups, but does not specifically model executive function.

papers.title: Earlier Postural and Cognitive Milestones in Parkinson's Disease with Comorbid Myasthenia Gravis.
papers.reason: The title indicates broad clinical cognitive outcomes in a specific comorbid group without a clear executive-function, modelling, or digital-biomarker contribution.

papers.title: Multimodal neuroimaging and electrophysiological signatures in amnestic mild cognitive impairment with different amyloid-β deposition status: correlations with cognitive function and diagnostic value
papers.reason: The study integrates resting EEG, structural MRI, PET, and cognitive scores to classify amyloid status in aMCI, closely matching multimodal early-impairment assessment.

papers.title: Left dorsomedial prefrontal cortex hyperactivation reflects early compensation for emerging social cognition difficulties in multiple sclerosis
papers.reason: The fMRI finding implicates a prefrontal executive hub in compensating for social-cognitive difficulty, but social cognition rather than executive function is the primary construct.

papers.title: Inhibition of miR-206 Ameliorates Seizures and Cognitive Deficits via BDNF/TrkB Signaling in Pilocarpine-Induced TLE Mice
papers.reason: The animal study identifies a molecular mechanism affecting spatial learning and memory in epilepsy, but it is not specifically directed at executive-function processes.

papers.title: Late-Onset Erotomanic Delusions, Cognitive Impairment, and Ventriculomegaly in an Older Adult Without Prior Psychiatric History: A Neuropsychiatric Case Report
papers.reason: This single case documents general cognitive impairment and impaired judgment but offers no systematic executive-function model or assessment methodology.

papers.title: Apolipoprotein as a Prognosis Factor of Ischemic Stroke Patient in Academic Hospital-Yogyakarta
papers.reason: The study relates blood lipid markers to broad cognitive screening scores after stroke, with no significant executive-specific or digital-biomarker result.

papers.title: Controlled deep breathing technique intervention effects on resting EEG, subjective psychological distress, and executive function performance in young adults
papers.reason: The randomized study links a breathing intervention to frontoparietal EEG changes and improved executive-function performance, providing relevant cognitive-control findings.

papers.title: Analysis of the Mediating Role of Cytokines in the Relationship Between Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease and Cognitive Impairment After Ischemic Stroke
papers.reason: The paper identifies an inflammatory mediator of general post-stroke cognitive impairment but does not isolate executive function or propose a cognitive process model.

papers.title: Altered Inter‐Network Functional Integration Underlies Speech Impairment in Parkinson's Disease: A Resting‐State fMRI Analysis
papers.reason: The study reports frontoparietal–auditory connectivity associated with speech dysfunction and global cognition, but executive function is secondary to the speech focus.

papers.title: Diagnostic accuracy of remote self-administered digital cognitive assessment by clinical diagnosis and Alzheimer’s disease PET imaging biomarkers
papers.reason: The large prospective study validates a scalable remote digital assessment against MCI, dementia, and PET biomarker groups, although it targets global cognition rather than executive function specifically.

papers.title: Comparative efficacy of various non-pharmacological therapies on cognitive function in patients with mild cognitive impairment or dementia
papers.reason: This network meta-analysis evaluates interventions using global cognitive scales rather than executive-function mechanisms or specialized assessment biomarkers.

papers.title: A previously unreported ELOVL4 frameshift variant in a patient with early severe cognitive decline, parkinsonism, and cerebellar ataxia
papers.reason: The report concerns a possible genetic cause of severe global cognitive decline in one patient without executive-specific measurement or modelling.

papers.title: Decomposing response inhibition: a POMDP model
papers.reason: The paper directly models human inhibitory control as a POMDP and uses amortized simulation-based inference to recover individual cognitive mechanisms linked to ADHD traits.
